raw_prompt: !update change the tnt bow, make it spawn 1000 primed tnt instead of just 1
reviewer_feedback: Updated the TNT Bow to spawn 1000 primed TNT entities upon impact instead of a single one.
usage_instructions: Use /give-tnt-bow to receive the upgraded TNT Bow.
Shoot an arrow to spawn 1000 primed TNT at the impact location.

mutations.content:
on shoot:
    if shooter is a player:
        if name of shooter's tool is "&cTNT Bow":
            set metadata "is_tnt_arrow" of projectile to true

on projectile hit:
    if metadata "is_tnt_arrow" of projectile is true:
        loop 1000 times:
            spawn primed tnt at location of projectile
        delete projectile

command /give-tnt-bow:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        give player a bow named "&cTNT Bow" with lore "&7Shoots 1000 explosive TNT arrows."

traces.intent_summary: Modify the TNT bow to spawn 1000 primed TNT entities upon firing instead of a single one.

traces.rationale: Updated the projectile hit event to include a loop that spawns 1000 primed tnt entities at the location of the projectile. Used standard Skript loop syntax to ensure compatibility without external addons.
